summary: Iteration 2 E2E validation of Lucy Play (Laravel) — image pipeline, redesigned admin forms, and lobby regression. Wrote pytest suite /app/tests/lucy_iteration2_test.py (37 tests) covering: storage symlink, member+guest lobby image render, game edit form sections & field persistence, image upload → DB → storage → lobby end-to-end on coin-flip, remove_image toggle, label badge (HOT #E5484D), agent create form (Identity/Security/Commission sections + POST persistence), Add-New game & category popovers with cleanup, Lucky Dice bet placement (POST /games/lucky-dice/play with stake+choice), and full 20-endpoint admin nav regression. All 37/37 tests pass. Playwright visual review confirms the redesigned game-edit form (Artwork/Catalogue/Display/Integration/Publishing sections with toggle switches) and agent-create form (Identity/Security/Commission sections) render as intended, and the Lucky Dice lobby card displays the uploaded artwork (http://127.0.0.1:8000/storage/games/test-lucky-dice.png).

issues: The uploaded artwork for Lucky Dice (test-lucky-dice.png, 4 KB) renders as a small centred logo on the card because the seeded test image is a low-resolution placeholder. Real 800×450+ hero art will fill the card correctly via .game-cover { object-fit: cover }. No CSS change needed, but consider replacing the seeded test-lucky-dice.png with a proper landscape cover for the demo.

Playwright query for '.popover-title' returned 0 elements in the initial DOM (only appears after the popover template is triggered). The class exists in lucy-admin.css and the templates include titles — this is expected lazy-render behaviour, not a bug.

critical_code_review_comments: GameEngineController::updateGame — when hasFile('image_upload') AND remove_image are both submitted, the current if/elseif keeps the newly uploaded image and ignores remove_image (upload wins). This is a reasonable priority order but not documented; add a code comment or reject the ambiguous combination in validation.

GameEngineController::updateGame — after successful upload the old file is deleted only if ((hasFile OR remove_image) AND oldImagePath). If a re-upload happens with the same target, the previously-stored file is orphaned. Consider adding a periodic cleanup job or reference count.

AgentController::store — the raw plaintext password is passed straight to Agent::create(). Confirm the Agent model has a 'password' => 'hashed' cast (Laravel 11's built-in hasher) or a mutator; otherwise agent login will fail even though the create flow returns success.
Game.php::getImageSourceAttribute uses asset() which honours APP_URL. If APP_URL is unset in prod, image URLs will fall back to the request host — fine for dev but flag for prod config.

lobby.blade.php duplicates the game-card markup twice (member + guest views). Extract into a Blade component @component('components.game-card', ['game' => $game]) to prevent drift between auth/guest cards.
seed_data_creation: None persisted. Test agents (nickname 'test_iter2_<timestamp>') deleted in-test. TEST_iter2_game deleted via admin UI in-test. TEST_iter2_cat category deleted via tinker in-test. Coin-flip's uploaded artwork + orphan file in /app/storage/app/public/game-images/ cleared and lobbies re-synced to []. lucky-dice's image_path preserved as games/test-lucky-dice.png per spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite lives at /app/tests/lucy_iteration2_test.py (37 tests, run in ~1.3s). It covers admin login, image upload/remove pipeline, edit form persistence via GET-after-PUT, agent create, add-new popovers, player lobby regression (incl. Lucky Dice /play), label badge rendering, and full admin nav regression. Uses ADMIN_EMAIL/PASS + PLAYER_EMAIL/PASS constants at top. Storage symlink /app/public/storage → /app/storage/app/public is confirmed working; php artisan storage:link is not needed. For UPLOAD tests, we hand-craft a 73-byte valid PNG via zlib — no filesystem asset required. All test data is prefixed with TEST_/test_iter2_ and cleaned up in the same test.
verified_flows: Admin upload artwork via /admin/game-engine/games/coin-flip/edit → image_path saved, /storage/game-images/.png returns 200, admin edit page re-renders , and adding the game to lobby #1 makes it appear on player lobby with
Remove artwork toggle: check remove_image=1 → image_path/image_url cleared, remove_image checkbox no longer rendered (view guarded by @if($game->image_source))

Game edit form persists all fields (title, slug, provider, category, sort_order, tag, label, label_background_color, art, symbol, top_game, demo_supported, free_bet_supported, crash, lobbies[]) — verified via GET after PUT
Label 'HOT' + background '#E5484D' rendered on lobby card as HOT
Agent create form POST /admin/agents → 'Agent created' flash on /admin/agents; nickname appears in listing

Add-New popover create category on /admin/game-engine?page=category works

Player lobby: search input filters cards live, provider filter has 5 options, Lucky Dice card renders uploaded image, POST /games/lucky-dice/play with stake=10, choice=even returns 200 (bet placed successfully as demo player)
20 admin routes return HTTP 200 with no Whoops/SQLSTATE errors (regression from iteration 1)
